title: School Sports Meet
audience: Chinese senior high school students (16-18 years old, average level in mainland China)
imageAlt: A school sports meet: three runners crossing the finish line, a big scoreboard, a high jump girl and cheering students in yellow
imageDescription: A school sports meet on a sunny day. A long white banner reading SCHOOL SPORTS MEET hangs above a red running track. On the right a big black scoreboard reads 100M RACE, 1. LI HUA 12.5S, 2. ZHANG PENG 13.2S, 3. WANG FANG 13.8S and NEXT: HIGH JUMP 2 PM. In the center three runners cross the white finish line tape: a boy in a red vest with number 1 raises both arms with a big smile, a boy in a blue vest with number 2 runs just behind him, and a girl in a green vest with number 3 runs third. All wear dark shorts and running shoes. On the left a girl in a navy tracksuit is in the air over a high jump bar above a thick blue mat. Beside the track students in yellow uniforms cheer with red and yellow pompoms, and some wave small flags. A coach in a blue tracksuit watches near the finish line. In the background there is a green sports field, a white school building with a small clock, green bushes and a blue sky with clouds.
scoringDescription: An outdoor school sports meet on a sunny day. A long white banner with blue capital letters reads SCHOOL SPORTS MEET above a red running track. On the right stands a big black scoreboard on posts with clear text: 100M RACE; 1. LI HUA 12.5S; 2. ZHANG PENG 13.2S; 3. WANG FANG 13.8S; NEXT: HIGH JUMP 2 PM. In the center three runners cross the white finish line tape together: first a smiling boy in a red vest with a large white number 1 raising both arms in celebration; just behind him a boy in a blue vest with number 2; third a girl in a green vest with number 3. All three wear dark shorts and running shoes. The scoreboard and the picture agree: Li Hua wins the 100m race in 12.5 seconds, Zhang Peng is second in 13.2 seconds, which is 0.7 seconds slower than Li Hua, and Wang Fang is third in 13.8 seconds, which is 1.3 seconds slower than Li Hua; in a race a bigger time means a slower runner. On the left a girl in a navy tracksuit jumps over a high jump bar that is still resting on its two stands, above a thick blue mat; she is in the air and has not touched or knocked down the bar. Beside the track students in yellow uniforms cheer with red and yellow pompoms, some wave small red and yellow flags, and a coach in a blue tracksuit watches the race near the finish line. In the background there is a green sports field with white lines, a white school building with a small clock, green bushes, and a blue sky with a few clouds.
